description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable class 'ImmutableMessagePath' that implements the 'MessagePath' interface. It provides methods to interpret and manipulate JSON pointers as message paths within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter, including extraction of feature IDs, message directions, and navigation of JSON pointer levels.

classes.name: ImmutableMessagePath
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the MessagePath interface that interprets JSON pointers as message paths and provides methods to access features and message directions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutableMessagePath instance from a JSON pointer.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Retrieves the feature ID from the JSON pointer if present.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Determines the message direction from the JSON pointer, if available.

methods.name: addLeaf
methods.description: Adds a leaf key to the JSON pointer and returns the new pointer.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends another JSON pointer to this one.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of levels in the JSON pointer.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the JSON pointer is empty.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON key at a specific level.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Gets the root key of the JSON pointer.

methods.name: getLeaf
methods.description: Gets the leaf key of the JSON pointer.

methods.name: cutLeaf
methods.description: Returns a new JSON pointer without the leaf element.

methods.name: nextLevel
methods.description: Advances to the next level of the JSON pointer.

methods.name: getSubPointer
methods.description: Retrieves a sub-pointer starting at a given level.

methods.name: getPrefixPointer
methods.description: Gets the prefix pointer up to a certain level.

methods.name: toFieldSelector

methods.name: length

methods.name: charAt

methods.name: subSequence

methods.name: iterator

methods.name: equals

methods.name: toString
